profiles.notes: 2026/2027 direct secondary entry. Published Tanzanian ACSEE scores and programme subjects use the local system.

requirements.label: Secondary certificate and subject credits
requirements.details: For first-degree admission the UDSM prospectus requires five approved CSEE subjects or their equivalents, including three credits achieved before the advanced secondary certificate.

source.title: UDSM undergraduate prospectus 2026/2027, printed p. 48

requirements.label: Tanzanian ACSEE grade scale
requirements.details: The guide lists ACSEE points as A = 5, B = 4, C = 3, D = 2, E = 1 and S = 0.5 for exams from 2016 onward. Use the point minimum and subject combination shown for the programme. The guide gives a separate scale for 2014 and 2015 examinations.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 4

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points
requirements.details: Choose two principal passes from History, Language, Geography, Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Advanced Mathematics. The TCU 2026/2027 table lists a minimum of 5 ACSEE points across three subjects.

source.title: TCU secondary guide 2026/2027, printed p. 273, UD001

requirements.label: Direct entry · required subjects and ACSEE points

requirements.label: Foreign school certificates · NECTA equivalence
requirements.details: Submit secondary certificates earned outside Tanzania to NECTA for equivalence grading before applying. The local programme subject and grade requirements are applied through that assessment.

source.title: UDSM international undergraduate qualification verification

requirements.label: Apply for a full undergraduate degree
requirements.details: Use the UDSM Online Admission System for the full-degree application. Prepare academic certificates, transcripts, qualification verification documents and identification as requested by the application.

source.title: UDSM international full-degree application and documents

requirements.label: Language of instruction and English evidence
requirements.details: Teaching is in English. Applicants from non-English-speaking countries may be asked to show English proficiency or follow language preparation guidance.

source.title: UDSM international language of instruction guidance

requirements.label: 8-4-4 school system route
requirements.details: The 2026/2027 prospectus calls for at least one year at a university in the applicant’s own country for applicants from an 8-4-4 education system before UDSM admission consideration.
